caption: A man in a black short-sleeved shirt sits at a light wooden table against a plain gray wall. He pinches a flat circular disc in his left hand on the right side of the frame. The disc has a mirror-like reflective top face and a beveled rim that flashes rainbow colors. His right hand, raised open with spread fingers near his cheek, gradually curls and lowers until it hovers just left of the disc. A black circular ring lies flat on the table in front of him, its inner surface catching a reflection of his forearm. Throughout the clip his mouth moves continuously as if speaking, and his brow furrows deeper over time. His head tilts downward and his gaze shifts from roughly toward the camera to the disc he holds. The disc is subtly re-tilted so its iridescent lower edge becomes more prominent, while the ring and table remain fixed.
